ColorValue.description: A colour: a palette index (0-175) or a colour name (see src/data/color-names.json for the names per palette).

CompanionLinesSpec.description: Recruit dialog lines for a companion.

offhand.description: Off hand: a shield or a second weapon.

head.description: Head model number. Default: a random head of the race and gender.

scale.description: Visual size in percent of normal, applied at spawn. Default: a small random variation (95-105).

CreatureSpec.description: One creature, described in names (maps to `build_creature`).

alignment.description: e.g. "lawful good", "chaotic neutral", "true neutral". Default: neutral, moved to fit the class.

build.description: spawn (default): a level-1 build that levels itself at spawn with the package (requested feats go into the level-1 slots; the package picks the rest). fixed: built at its level now with the requested feats first (non-casters).

class.description: Base class name: barbarian, bard, cleric, druid, fighter, monk, paladin, ranger, rogue, sorcerer, wizard.

conversation.description: Resref of an existing dialog to attach (npc and enemy).

domains.description: Cleric only: two domain names, e.g. ["War", "Strength"]. Default: the package's domains.

faction.description: Default by role: companion and npc commoner, enemy hostile. A standard faction name or a custom faction's name.

feats.description: Feat names, e.g. "Power Attack", "Cleave", "Weapon Focus (Bastard Sword)". Prerequisites are added and reported.

gear.description: Items to make and equip. With any gear given, the creature keeps exactly this gear (no shopping at spawn).

level.description: Level the creature has in play.

package.description: Feat and skill progression (packages.2da): a package name of the class ("Fighter, Weapon Master (Katana)", "Fighter, Gladiator"), "auto" (the class package whose feat list holds the most requested feats) or omitted (the class's default package; "auto" when feats are given).

powerLevel.description: Default "standard"; "tougher" and "epic" are for a real boss.

race.description: Player race name: dwarf, elf, gnome, halfling, half-elf, half-orc, human.

resref.description: Blueprint resref, also the tag: lower-case letters, digits and underscore, at most 16 characters.

role.description: companion: recruitable henchman (Commoner faction, henchman AI, recruit dialog). npc: a friendly character. enemy: hostile.

school.description: Wizard only: school name, e.g. "Evocation" ("General" for none). Default: the package's school.

spells.description: Casters: spell names always picked first at their level (a signature spell), e.g. ["Fireball"].

GearItemSpec.description: One item to make and equip.

base.description: What it is: a base item name ("bastard sword", "large shield", "helmet", "cloak") or, for `armor`, an armor name ("padded", "leather", "studded leather", "hide", "chain shirt", "scale mail", "chainmail", "breastplate", "splint mail", "banded mail", "half plate", "full plate", "clothing").

color.description: Colour of the item's parts. A plain value sets both metal colours (armour, helmet, shield).

name.description: Display name; default the base item's name (with the properties' bonus, e.g. "Bastard Sword +1").

properties.description: Item properties in words: "<property> [<subtype>] [<value>]", e.g. "attack bonus +1", "enhancement +2", "ac bonus +1", "ability bonus strength +2", "damage bonus fire 1d6", "keen".

bearing.description: Compass facing in degrees (0 north, 90 east).
